visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two individuals, one a male comedian in elderly female drag (Hanhan) and the other an older woman, are seated on a patterned sofa in a domestic living room. Hanhan is wearing a brown wig, glasses, a red shirt, and a colorful patterned apron, while holding a small porcelain tea cup. In the background, a large aquarium with swimming fish and wooden cabinets are visible. (2) Hanhan uses a pair of blue scissors to cut pieces of red meat jerky into smaller strips on a glass coffee table. They are both eating the jerky and talking animatedly; the older woman wears a teal lace-detailed shirt and glasses. The lighting is warm and comes from indoor fixtures. (3) A graphic transition leads to a studio setting with a clean white background. Hanhan is wearing a red shirt and a white scarf, holding bags of Go Lucky (Keke Nayu) coconut biscuits. The packaging features a distinct cassette tape graphic. Close-ups of the biscuits and the scanning process on a smartphone screen are shown. (4) Hanhan is seen wearing headphones, dancing enthusiastically under colorful, warm disco-style lighting while holding the biscuit package. The camera uses dynamic medium shots and close-ups to highlight his expressions. (5) The scene returns to the living room setup. The two friends finish their snacks and prepare to leave. They engage in a competitive rock-paper-scissors game over several framed photographs of elderly women placed on the table. Hanhan eventually gathers several frames and stands up to depart.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track features two primary speakers engaging in casual, comedic dialogue. The dominant voice belongs to a male actor using a high-pitched, feminine characterization, speaking a mix of Mandarin and Hokkien with high energy. Ambient indoor room tone is low. (2) Discrete sound effects include the rhythmic clicking of scissors cutting food and the audible crunch of snacks being eaten. The second voice, an older woman, maintains a natural conversational tone, frequently interrupted by laughter from both parties. (3) A sharp 'whoosh' transition leads into a high-energy electronic music track with a prominent synthesizer beat and a tempo of approximately 124 BPM. A resonant male narrator provides rhythmic slogans over the music. (4) Digital UI pings and notification-style sound effects are layered over the continuous music during an instructional promotional sequence. The character's voice increases in pitch and arousal to convey excitement about the product's new feature. (5) The music fades out, returning to the domestic room ambience. Rapid clapping sounds signify a rock-paper-scissors game. The track ends with the shuffling sound of furniture and a friendly closing remark from the main character.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video utilizes a popular comedic persona (Hanhan) to deliver a cross-promotional advertisement for 'Go Lucky' (Keke Nayu) milk biscuits and Spotify. It frames the product's new Spotify-integrated packaging within a nostalgic and humorous story about aging and long-term friendship, aiming to drive brand engagement through character-driven entertainment.
